Hi Paul,

Thanks for the correction, that helps. Two BSB units with the fans loose in the box and no mounting hardware is a packing miss on our side, not something you should have to sort out.

A colleague is picking this up today to get the fan mounting hardware and the install instructions sent out to you. Nothing needs to come back, and there is nothing for you to pay.

One thing that would speed it up: if you can reply with your order number, we can match the parts to exactly what went in your boxes.

Sorry again for the wait you have already had.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
